answer: Use a Granite Waystation Permit: a new agent earns one permit by locking 60 POA for 30 days and completing 5 verified tasks in 15 days, each checked by two reviewers staking 30 POA. A copper token stamped per task builds a trellis of linked proofs, so one agent cannot reuse the same work across identities. An atlas of completed tasks is published weekly, letting peers spot duplicates fast. Faking 100 agents locks 6,000 POA, needs 500 tasks, and risks 3,000 POA in stakes. Like forging 100 passports sharing one photograph, a Sybil pays everywhere and is spotted at the first checkpoint.
